ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area with scattered high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters; estimated area ratio of approximately 15:85 (white to black).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of high-intensity white annular rings and solid dots across the dark background. Pixel density of these blobs increases significantly toward the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal vertex angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and a high pixel depth relative to the vertical axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing edge. Notable sequence of stochastic peaks and valleys (2-8 pixel amplitude) creating a jagged boundary, especially on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex parabolic curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular and ring-shaped white pixel groups (rosettes) measuring 5-15 pixels in diameter, concentrated on the lateral margins and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the medial-lower portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged defect on the distal-lateral edge of the left lobe; extensive barnacle colonization and resulting scarring across approximately 25% of the visible surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of active barnacle clusters at the extreme distal margins appearing as high-contrast, irregular protruding masses that break the smooth geometric contour of the fluke tips.
